description: Static 2D radius scaling at four million uniform integer points
name: radius_scaling
query_design: Fixed radii as fractions of uint32 grid width; identical indexed points and query centers across radii for each seed.
title: radius_scaling
radius_policy: Round radius_fraction * UINT32_MAX to nearest integer; square this integer exactly. No pilot calibration.

radius_design.boundary_effects: Query centers cover the whole cube; balls intersecting boundaries return fewer points. Actual counts are measured.
